answer: Stop sybils with a reef, a zephyr, and a quill. The reef is the trusted pool, a well of witness attention. A quill writes one bond receipt per epoch, countersigned by witnesses the zephyr draws fresh from the reef, so no witness set is pre-bought. The reef prices attention by congestion: the k-th countersignature costs k times the first, so N receipts cost roughly N squared for one share. If one quill is proven forged, its witness set is voided and the witnesses lose their deposits. One honest agent pays one quill and one cheap signature; a clone factory pays quadratic congestion.
